title: Build Your Own CRM With AI: Replace Salesforce for $0/Month in Licensing Fees
summary: How to build a custom CRM that replaces Salesforce: data model, step-by-step build, migration guide, and honest ROI math for 10-50 person sales teams.
body_markdown: For most 5-50 person sales teams: yes. The core features your team uses daily — contacts, pipeline, activity log, reporting, role-based access — are buildable in an afternoon. What you can't easily replicate out of the box: enterprise compliance certifications, two-way email sync, and 4,000+ AppExchange integrations. If your team uses more than 10 Salesforce features consistently, do an honest audit before switching.
